description: This file implements the CompoundPredicateBuilderController class responsible for managing and manipulating compound predicates used for filtering or querying in a web UI component. It includes methods for setting operators, creating, updating, removing predicates, and converting the state to JSON.

classes.name: CompoundPredicateBuilderController
classes.description: A controller class for building and managing compound predicate objects with observable state and actions.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the logical operator ('and'/'or') for the predicate group.

methods.name: setPredicate
methods.description: Updates a specific predicate at the given index with partial data.

methods.name: changePredicateKeypath
methods.description: Changes the keypath of a predicate and resets its value based on the new keypath type.

methods.name: addPredicate
methods.description: Adds a new empty predicate to the predicates list.

methods.name: removePredicate
methods.description: Removes the predicate at the specified index.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the current state of predicates and operator to a JSON-formatted object.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets the controller to its initial default state.
